# Fortiview Holdings

> Fortiview Holdings is the parent company behind industrial automation and technical training, PragOptics technology, and the Idea Lab. Based in League City, Texas. Contact: support@fortiviewholdings.com, +1 (832) 425-0421.

Fortiview Holdings designs and integrates industrial automation and instrumentation systems, provides hands-on technical training (including community-college instruction), and operates PragOptics, its technology arm. PragOptics is a creation platform — where ideas become real: open hardware you can buy assembled or build free from the published designs (schematics, BOMs, print-ready case files), a studio for building, publishing, and monetizing websites, web apps, and APIs, Field Node Manager for pairing software with hardware, and a 3D Suite for modeling and slicing. PragOptics makes OmniBus, the universal HART communicator and calibration recorder, and OmniSource, the pocket loop-power supply, and also powers business automation and workflows, managed Microsoft 365, dashboards, and connected apps. Fortiview also runs the Idea Lab, a free coding and cybersecurity academy for kids.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://fortiviewholdings.com/): Parent company overview.
- [Industrial Automation & Technical Training](https://fortiviewholdings.com/industrial/): Instrumentation and controls, PLC and DCS, motor and relay logic, calibration, PID and safety instrumented functions, IT/OT integration, and hands-on technical training. Fifteen years of field experience.
- [Partnerships](https://fortiviewholdings.com/partnerships/): A vetted network of vendors and integrators. Vendor network, bulk procurement, co-selling, referrals, integration partners.
- [PragOptics](https://fortiviewholdings.com/integration/): The technology arm — a creation platform where ideas become real. Open hardware (OmniBus, the universal HART communicator and calibration recorder; OmniSource, the pocket loop-power supply) sold assembled or built free from published designs; the PragOptics studio for building, publishing, and monetizing websites, web apps, and APIs; Field Node Manager; the PragOptics 3D Suite for modeling and slicing; plus automation and workflows, managed Microsoft 365, dashboards, security and audit, and iOS and connected apps. Tiers are User at $7.50, Partner at $49, and Super at $350 per user per month, with 10 percent off annual billing. Subscribe and manage at https://pragoptics.com.
- [Idea Lab](https://fortiviewholdings.com/idea-lab/): A free, cosmic coding and cybersecurity academy for kids. Teaches how a rock becomes a computer, online safety, how AI works, and how to launch an idea. No accounts, no cost, runs in the browser.
- [Field Pocket Guide](https://fortiviewholdings.com/education/): Free instrumentation calculators and reference tables — calibration error (percent of span), signal scaling, square-root flow extraction, RTD and thermocouple tables (IEC 60751, ITS-90), field formulas, and an interactive numbering-systems lab (binary, octal, hex, BCD, ASCII, two's complement). No accounts, runs in the browser, works offline once loaded.
